commands.name: office-space
commands.description: Open or close the Office Space panel (16-bit office of running agents)

commands.name: office-space-band
commands.description: Show or hide the small office strip above the prompt

commands.name: office-space-help
commands.description: List every Office Space command and setting
commands.output:
Office Space commands:
  /office-space - Open or close the Office Space panel (16-bit office of running agents)
  /office-space-band - Show or hide the small office strip above the prompt
  /office-space-help - List every Office Space command and setting
  /office-space-update - Check GitHub for a newer version of Office Space and update it
  /office-space-feedback - Report a bug or share an idea (shows the link and your version details)
  /office-space-roster - Who is at work, for how long, and what each is doing (uses a little plan usage for the summaries)
  /office-space-recap - Today's hand-ins, failures, outside workers that needed you, and Employee of the Day
  /office-space-usage - Context fill, plan limits with reset times, and cost
  /office-space-workers - Show the outside-workers folder, who was read from it, and any files skipped and why
  /office-space-boss [silver hair, a white tee, blue jeans | parts | reset] - Change how the Boss looks, in plain words or step by step (uses a little plan usage)
  /office-space-office [teal walls, a vending machine | remove couch | list | reset] - Decorate the office: walls, floor, vending machine, arcade and more, in plain words or step by step (uses a little plan usage)
  /office-space-team [call the Coder "Mx. Bytes" | give the Coder my cowboy hat | parts | reset <role>] - Rename roles, restyle them and set the starting desk count, in words or step by step (uses a little plan usage)
  /office-space-theme [save <name> | load <name or path> | list | reset] - Save, load, list or reset a whole look (Boss, team, office); includes three presets (no plan usage)

Settings (/plugin -> office-space -> configure): workersDir, staleMinutes, alertOnBlocked, checkForUpdates, showUsage.
Only /office-space-roster, and /office-space-boss, /office-space-team and /office-space-office (with words, or Other), make an AI call (one small-model request per ask, outside your chat). Pressing Draw it for something the catalog lacks makes one

commands.name: office-space-theme
commands.description: Save, load, list or reset a whole look (Boss, team, office); includes three presets (no plan usage)
commands.output:
Save your look, share it, or load someone else's. /office-space-theme save <name> writes a small JSON file (~/.claude/office-space/themes/<name>.json) with your Boss, team and office, and any drawn parts they wear. load <name or path> reads one back, after showing what will change and asking you to confirm. list shows the built-in presets and your saved themes, and reset puts every default back. A theme file is data only: it is checked key by key and nothing in it is ever run. Themes use no AI and no plan usage.

Built-in presets:
  90s startup
  cozy library
  night shift

No saved themes yet (they go in /Users/dev/.claude/office-space/themes).
